_about: Skill discovery locations for coding agents. Paths are templates: 'project' is relative to the project root, 'user' is relative to the user's home directory. The installer selects the FIRST path listed for the requested scope; remaining entries are documented alternatives and are not auto-detected. 'evidence' describes source quality, not a runtime test: official (vendor documentation), codelab (vendor tutorial), third-party (secondary source), conflicting (vendor sources disagree; verify on installed version), none (no documented skill directory). Re-verify every entry when upgrading the agent. Last researched: 2026-10-14.

targets.label: Claude Code
targets.notes: Project skills in <repo>/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; personal skills in ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

targets.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
targets.notes: The current Codex skills overview documents .agents/skills for repository discovery, $HOME/.agents/skills for user discovery, and /etc/codex/skills for administrator discovery. The official openai/codex skill-creator sample still recommends $CODEX_HOME/skills (default ~/.codex/skills) as a creation destination. The sources disagree; this installer follows the current discovery overview, and users must verify discovery in their installed version.

targets.label: OpenCode
targets.notes: The current official docs support .agents/skills, .opencode/skills, and Claude-compatible .claude/skills for projects; the corresponding user paths are ~/.agents/skills, ~/.config/opencode/skills, and ~/.claude/skills. The installer defaults to the shared Agent Skills location.

targets.label: Gemini CLI
targets.notes: Official docs support .agents/skills and .gemini/skills at project and user scope. The installer prefers the shared Agent Skills directory. Gemini also provides 'gemini skills link' for symlinked development installs.

targets.label: Zed (Zed Agent)
targets.notes: Zed reads ~/.agents/skills for users and .agents/skills for projects. Skills apply to the Zed Agent only, not to external agents. Project skills load only from trusted worktrees. The folder name must match the name field in SKILL.md.

targets.label: Google Antigravity
targets.notes: Current official docs say .agents/skills is the default and .agent/skills remains backward-compatible. App/IDE user skills live in ~/.gemini/config/skills; Antigravity CLI user skills instead live in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills. For CLI user scope, pass --dest-dir ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills.

targets.label: Cursor
targets.notes: Current official docs explicitly support .agents/skills and .cursor/skills at project scope, and ~/.agents/skills and ~/.cursor/skills at user scope. The installer defaults to the shared Agent Skills location. Cursor reads nested SKILL.md files under its skill roots; this suite's skills must remain siblings to resolve peer references.

targets.label: GitHub Copilot (VS Code agent)
targets.notes: Current Microsoft docs for the VS Code Copilot agent support .github/skills, .claude/skills, and .agents/skills for projects, and ~/.copilot/skills, ~/.claude/skills, and ~/.agents/skills for users. The installer defaults to the shared Agent Skills directory. The GitHub CLI 'gh skill install' command is a separate host-aware install option; the Rustacean installer does not depend on it.

targets.label: Freebuff (Codebuff)
targets.notes: Codebuff's skills page documents .agents/skills and .claude/skills, project and global, with project skills taking priority. Freebuff is the free CLI of the same project; its skill paths come from the upstream CLI documentation index and are not confirmed on the installed version. Freebuff also reads AGENTS.md natively.

targets.label: Meta Muse Code
targets.notes: Project skills are skipped unless the workspace is trusted (muse skills list --source project --trust-workspace). Run 'muse skills list' after installing to confirm discovery. The official reference is https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code, which was not retrieved.

targets.label: Kimi Code CLI (Moonshot)
targets.notes: Current Kimi Code CLI docs explicitly support .agents/skills and .kimi-code/skills (with KIMI_CODE_HOME affecting the latter). Older kimi-cli docs describe ~/.kimi/skills and --skills-dir. The shared .agents/skills path is the current default target, but this entry remains 'conflicting' to force installed-version verification; use --accept-conflicting or --dest-dir only after checking your version.

targets.label: Z.AI ZCode
targets.notes: Current official ZCode docs document .zcode/skills at workspace scope and ~/.zcode/skills at user scope, plus importing skills from other agents. This entry covers Z.AI ZCode; it is unrelated to the open-source simonyos/Z-CODE project.
